unit_definition: One passage per visual block: each run of prose lines between displayed formulas, each displayed formula or list, and the footnote. A logical paragraph that runs through a display is several passages. Joining a display to the prose around it is a grouping difference, not an ownership error.
non_text: Every piece of the footnote rule is labeled separator. The line finder classes its right three pieces as rules. It classes the broken left end (fragments 2-4 pixels high at y 2202-2206, x 320-728) as text and attaches them to lines 47 and 49 or to no line; a component rule labels them separator.
